environment.description: EKS 1.28 cluster running Step Functions HTTP task integration. Pod runs in 'workflows' namespace with default service account. No NetworkPolicy applied. Pod has unrestricted egress. IMDS endpoint (169.254.169.254) accessible from pod network. Node IAM role has s3:*, secretsmanager:GetSecretValue attached. Container runs as root with hostPath volume mount to /var/run/docker.sock for legacy log collection.
